description: Hospital Plans Ahead, Serves the Community Through Power Outage is a case study listed in U.S. Climate Resilience Toolkit, a national climate-adaptation toolkit, published or maintained by Greenwich Hospital. The combined heat and power system at Greenwich Hospital in Connecticut kept the lights on through Hurricane Sandy, and the system continues to support community resilience. Coverage: Greenwich Hospital, Connecticut (2015). The toolkit gives Connecticut as the location, 2015 as the year. The listed link gives the documented application. Access is free of charge and open. The licence is not stated on the toolkit page (no licence or terms statement seen). Caveats: this record was written from the toolkit page, which was read; the cited source documents and the outcomes reported were not checked, and no model or dataset used was verified. It can support comparison with similar adaptation projects and planning precedents. Related record: the catalogue-level record data-us-climate-resilience-toolkit-catalogue.
